_doc: Per-family expected deliverable artifacts for the deterministic delivery validator (PREREGISTRATION.md section 4: existence/schema, not quality). Derived firsthand from the required-structure / concrete-deliverables sections of tooling/tasks/*.md at this checkout. Spec forms: {path,kind} exact root-relative path in workspace_final.tar.gz; {basename,kind} non-empty file anywhere in the tree; {anyof:[...]} first match wins. Kinds: file|md (non-empty), json (parses), dir (exists, non-empty).
_doc_freeze_fix: Preregistration-freeze correction (2026-08-16, before any corrective cell runs): artifacts the briefs explicitly mark optional are NOT delivery-gated, since gating them would misclassify brief-compliant deliveries as non-delivered. Removed on that basis: p2_extract notes.md + decisions/ (brief: you may also produce), p2_hallucination notes.md + decisions/ (brief structure marks both optional), p2_triage README.md + decisions/ (brief: you may produce), p3_doc research/dead-ends.md (brief: optional), p3_pm decisions/ (brief: Optional). Entries listed in a brief required-structure block without an optional marker remain gated. Under-requirement is left as-is (lenient symmetric across models): e.g. p2_ci pyproject.toml, p1_bugfix benchmarks/ + decisions/ + research/notes/ are brief-required but not gated here.
